finalText:
**Migration done.** 36 call sites across 12 files now use `db.execute({ sql, params })`. Every file passes `node --check`.

One file left on the old call: [vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9](vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9). Its header says do not edit, since upgrades overwrite it. That needs an upstream fix or a wrapper.

I left `cache.query` alone. Different API, not part of this move.
